title: Completa la frase
intro: [cheerful] Lee la frase, piensa la palabra y dila antes que yo.

items.sentence: When I was five, I ____ read.

outro: [excited] ¿Hasta qué número llegaste? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.

full_script: [cheerful] Lee la frase, piensa la palabra y dila antes que yo. I can swim very well. You should see a doctor. Could you help me, please? Ahora, nivel intermedio. When I was five, I could read. You must be tired after that trip. You don't have to come if you don't want to. You mustn't smoke here. It's forbidden. Y ahora, nivel experto. She can't have been at home, I called. You'd better hurry up. You ought to see a doctor about that cough. Si te quedaste en la tres, básico. En la siete, intermedio. Y con las diez, experto. [excited] ¿Hasta qué número llegaste? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
